people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:
translations.bsb: Jacob spent the night there, and from what he had brought with him, he selected a gift for his brother Esau:
translations.kjv: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
translations.asv: And he lodged there that night, and took of that which he had with him a present for Esau his brother:
